info.title: tamp — small-core, plugin-driven build automation framework
info.description: Tamp global tool. Install via `dotnet tool install -g Tamp.Cli`; invoke as `tamp <target>`. For the `dotnet tamp <target>` form, install the sibling `dotnet-tamp` package instead.

commands.name: init
commands.description: scaffold Build.cs into the current dir

options.name: --template
options.description: Pick a non-minimal template (minimal | library | monorepo)

options.name: --settings-style
options.description:
Wrapper settings shape in scaffolded Build.cs (fluent | init).
fluent (default) → DotNet.Build(s => s.SetProject(...))
init             → DotNet.Build(new() { Project = ... })

options.name: --solution
options.description: Explicit .NET solution path (otherwise auto-detected)

options.name: --tamp-version
options.description:
Pin this Tamp version (Tamp.Core, Tamp.NetCli.V10, dotnet-tamp);
skips the NuGet lookup

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print would-write list; touch nothing

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files

options.name: --list-templates
options.description: List templates from all registered sources

options.name: --help
options.description:
This message
RESERVED (parsed; not implemented):

options.name: --template-source
options.description: (0.3.0)  Pin a specific NuGet template package

options.name: --offline
options.description: (0.3.0)  Refuse network fallback

options.name: --with-ci
options.description: (0.3.0)  Emit CI workflow files

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
(0.4.0)  Prompt for choices
ENVIRONMENT:
TAMP_INIT_FEED_URL   NuGet v3 flat-container base URL for the version lookup
(default https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/)

commands.name: nuke
commands.description: Executes a tool from source without permanently installing it.

options.name: --version
options.description: The version of the tool package to install.

options.name: --allow-roll-forward
options.description:
Allow a .NET tool to roll forward to newer versions
of the .NET runtime if the runtime it targets isn't
installed. [default: False]

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include pre-release packages. [default: False]

options.name: --configfile
options.description: The NuGet configuration file to use.

options.name: --source
options.description:
Replace all NuGet package sources to use during
installation with these.

options.name: --add-source
options.description:
Add an additional NuGet package source to use
during installation.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description:
Set the MSBuild verbosity level. Allowed values are
q[uiet], m[inimal], n[ormal], d[etailed], and
diag[nostic]. [default: normal]

options.name: --disable-parallel
options.description:
Prevent restoring multiple projects in parallel.
[default: False]

options.name: --ignore-failed-sources
options.description: Treat package source failures as warnings.

options.name: --no-http-cache
options.description:
Do not cache packages and http requests. [default:
False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
Allows the command to stop and wait for user input
or action (for example to complete authentication).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show command line help.

arguments.name: PACKAGEID
arguments.description:
Package reference in the form of a package identifier
like 'dotnetsay' or package identifier and version
separated by '@' like 'dotnetsay@2.1.7'.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print every CommandPlan that would run; execute nothing.

options.name: --plan
options.description: Render the target dependency graph; execute nothing.

options.name: --list
options.description: List top-level targets (or all, if none are marked).

options.name: --list-tree
options.description: List targets with their dependencies.

options.name: --all
options.description: Used with --list / --list-tree: show internal targets too.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: quiet | minimal | normal | verbose | diagnostic

options.name: --quiet
options.description:
Shortcuts for --verbosity quiet | --verbosity verbose
Tamp locates a build project under build/, _build/, or .tamp/build/ in the
current working tree (or an ancestor) and forwards the invocation to it.
Documentation: https://github.com/tamp-build/tamp
